hero.leadText: VisionTech Engineering Ltd. (VEL) is a dynamic EPC contractor delivering turnkey engineering, 132/33kV power substations, underground transmission cable protection, and heavy logistics for government utilities and private industrial leaders across Bangladesh.

services.title: 132/33kV Substations & Cable Laying
services.desc: Turnkey transmission grid substations, GIS/AIS installations, high-voltage underground cable trenching, jointing, and precast protection slabs.

services.title: Heavy Civil Infrastructure & Foundations
services.desc: Deep pile foundations, heavy equipment machine foundations, water reservoirs, drainage retaining structures, and national bridge auxiliary civil works.

services.title: Electro-Mechanical (MEP) & Interior
services.desc: Industrial HVAC ventilation, electrical busbar trunking, emergency power generation synchronization, fire hydrant protection, and corporate fit-outs.

services.title: Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings (PEB)
services.desc: Heavy structural steel fabrication, industrial multi-story factories, logistics warehouses, and large-span covered warehouses built to international ASTM standards.

projects.title: 400/230/132kV GIS Grid Substation Project
projects.scope: Civil foundations, control building construction, GIS equipment erection, transformer bay earthing, and drainage infrastructure.

projects.title: 360 MW Combined Cycle Power Plant Foundations
projects.scope: Heavy machinery foundations, dynamic load vibration absorption pits, circulating cooling water trenches, and auxiliary steel structural framing.

projects.title: 132kV Underground Transmission Cable Route Protection
projects.scope: Trench excavation in dense urban corridors, RCC duct bank placement, and installation of 100,000+ pcs proprietary precast interlocking protection slabs.

projects.title: Heavy Industrial Pre-Engineered Steel Manufacturing Facility
projects.scope: Clear-span PEB steel building design, fabrication, on-site erection, heavy overhead crane girder installation, and high-spec industrial flooring.

sisterConcern.desc: Operating as VisionTech's integrated logistics backbone, Swadesh Carrying Agency guarantees self-reliant transport of heavy power transformers, turbines, and oversized construction cargo across all national highways and river waterways in Bangladesh.
